brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Two-tier structure: level 0 bases at 0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1 with level 1 bases at 0,0 and 1,0; plain covers at 0,1,0;top, 0,0,1;top and 1,0,1;top provide shelf surfaces, capped and joint-bolted.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator checks fit/collisions only; parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material. No load testing, material strength, or certification is available, so a 50 kg rating cannot be verified or claimed. Geometry provides flat shelf surfaces for books as staging (book prop on cover:0,0,1;full;top).

Two notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#-1,0#notch5 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm at -1,0,0 k5) and notch:0#-1,2#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm at -1,2,0 k1) between the cells leaving empty notch cells for storage.

finish.summary: Built a two-level shelf unit with two notch drawer frames and dressed with books to show use. Load rating to 50 kg cannot be provided or verified by the configurator/material choice and is marked unmet.

M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
